name: Challenger Failure
excerpt: The Challenger failure was due to an O-Ring issue and communication breakdown.
notes: The Challenger disaster was caused by a failure with the O-Ring. There was a communication breakdown where people at lower levels could not communicate effectively with top levels.
context_summary:
- The Challenger failure was due to an O-Ring issue.
- There was a communication breakdown.
- Lower-level personnel could not communicate effectively with top levels.
